query: INSERT INTO account_email_proofs (user_id, purpose, email, token_hash, created_at, expires_at) SELECT $1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text, $4::bytea, c.t, c.t + make_interval(secs => $5::int) FROM (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t) c ON CONFLICT (user_id, purpose) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at RETURNING expires_at
